title: Implement create --project and new_issue_project routing for virtual projects
description: Found while removing the simulated virtual-project CLI (kbs-215bc6f0). Specs in features/issues/ (virtual-project creation feature, scenarios around lines 13, 19, 26, 40, 52) describe 'kanbus create --project <label>' and routing new issues by the new_issue_project config value, including an 'ask' mode that prompts. Neither runtime implements them: --project is rejected as an unexpected argument and new_issue_project is validated but never used. The scenarios are tagged @wip pointing at this ticket. Work: confirm with docs/ and the configuration reference that this behavior is wanted (if not, delete the scenarios instead and say so), then implement identically in Rust and Python and remove the @wip tags. Acceptance: the scenarios pass in both runtimes without @wip.
